result.instructions: Tools for SkyPrep, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which learners have not finished the new hire orientation course yet?"; "Enroll jane.doe@acme.com in the food safety course."; "List the user groups and how many people are in each one.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes SkyPrep data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run skyprep_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run skyprep_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run skyprep_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. skyprep_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: skyprep_list_users
tools.title: List users
tools.description: List learners, managers and admins in the SkyPrep account, with optional filters. Paged with `page`. API: get_users.

created_within_the_past_day.description: Only users created in the past 24 hours.

include_learning_paths.description: Include each user's learning path memberships.

tools.name: skyprep_get_user
tools.title: Get a user
tools.description: Get one user's profile by user_id or user_email. API: get_user.

user_id.description: SkyPrep user id. Give this or user_email.

user_email.description: The user's email address (username). Give this or user_id.

tools.name: skyprep_list_courses
tools.title: List courses
tools.description: List the courses in the SkyPrep account, with their codes, categories and course ids. API: get_courses.

tools.name: skyprep_get_course
tools.title: Get a course
tools.description: Get one course by course_id, including its items and catalog settings. API: get_course.

tools.name: skyprep_get_user_courses
tools.title: List a user's courses
tools.description: List the courses one user is enrolled in, by user_email. API: get_user_courses.

tools.name: skyprep_get_user_course_status
tools.title: Get a user's course status
tools.description: Get one user's status in one course: passed, failed, not-started, in-progress or archived. API: get_user_course_status.

user_id.description: SkyPrep user id. Give this or user_email.

user_email.description: The user's email address (username). Give this or user_id.

tools.name: skyprep_list_user_groups
tools.title: List user groups
tools.description: List the user groups (departments, teams, cohorts) in the SkyPrep account. API: get_user_groups.

tools.name: skyprep_get_user_group
tools.title: Get a user group
tools.description: Get one user group by user_group_id, with its members. API: get_user_group.

user_group_id.description: The SkyPrep user group id (from skyprep_list_user_groups).

tools.name: skyprep_list_learning_paths
tools.title: List learning paths
tools.description: List the learning paths in the SkyPrep account. API: get_learning_paths.

tools.name: skyprep_get_course_progresses
tools.title: Get course progress
tools.description: Get course progress records, filtered by course, user and status. Status is passed, failed, not-started, in-progress, not-applicable or archived. API: get_course_progresses.

status.description: Status filter, comma separated, for example failed,in-progress.

enrolled.description: true: only users still enrolled. false: only users not enrolled.

tools.name: skyprep_create_user
tools.title: Create a user
tools.description: Create a learner, content manager or manager. Admin accounts cannot be created here. Writes to the SkyPrep account. API: create_user.

email.description: The new user's email address (username). Must be unique.

card_no.description: Unique identifier, for example a staff or badge number.

tools.name: skyprep_update_user
tools.title: Update a user
tools.description: Update a user's name, title, identifier or phone numbers. Only the fields you pass change. Roles, admin and manager flags, and access dates cannot be changed here. Writes to the SkyPrep account. API: update_user.

user_email.description: The user's email address (username) to update.

card_no.description: New unique identifier, for example a staff or badge number.

tools.name: skyprep_enroll_user_in_course
tools.title: Enroll a user in a course
tools.description: Enroll one user in one course, by user_id or user_email, with an optional enrollment expiry date. Writes to the SkyPrep account. API: enroll_user_in_course.

user_id.description: SkyPrep user id. Give this or user_email.

user_email.description: The user's email address (username). Give this or user_id.

course_id.description: The SkyPrep course id to enroll the user in.

course_enrollment_expiration_date.description: When the enrollment ends, as a date or date-time string (for example 2027-06-30).

annotations.title: Enroll a user in a course

tools.name: skyprep_enroll_user_in_user_group
tools.title: Add a user to a user group
tools.description: Add one user to one user group, with an optional membership expiry date. Writes to the SkyPrep account. API: enroll_user_in_user_group.

user_id.description: The SkyPrep user id (from skyprep_list_users or skyprep_get_user).

user_group_id.description: The SkyPrep user group id (from skyprep_list_user_groups).

user_group_enrollment_expiration_date.description: When the membership ends, as a date or date-time string.

annotations.title: Add a user to a user group
